title: Check-count gate is opt-in: a test file without EXPECTED_CHECKS silently skips the r2-B2 anti-phantom-check trip
detail: A future test file added to the runner list without the const gets expected=-1, skipping the count gate — exactly the 'checks silently eaten' regression mode r2 B2 added this gate for. The completed flag still guards aborts, but not check-eating.
recommended_fix: Fail the file when pinned == null (require the pin for every runner-listed script), matching test_base.gd's stated intent that the runner fails any shortfall.

title: determinism_log.gd hardcodes the seed literal 4x instead of sharing base.SEED, weakening its own no-drift design
evidence:
a.setup(20260904, WorldSeed.node_placements(20260904, WorldSeed.wedge_layout(20260904)))
	b.setup(20260904, WorldSeed.node_placements(20260904, WorldSeed.wedge_layout(20260904)))
...	lines.append("seed=%d ticks=%d commands=%d (three-wedge network + a 50/30/20 set_lanes)" % [20260904, ticks, cmds.size()])
(tests/test_sim_base.gd:7: const SEED := 20260904)
detail: The tool loads REPLAY_CMDS/REPLAY_TICKS/REPLAY_INJECT_TICK from test_sim_base but re-hardcodes the seed; if the test seed changes, the committed capture silently mirrors a different scenario than the replay test.
recommended_fix: Read the seed from the shared harness — var seed_v: int = base.SEED — and use it in both setup calls and the header line.
